It takes twenty minutes to get to the cashier by bike. Jack hopes to visit Chengdu one day. Jack bought a pair of shoes at the shop yesterday. Mom is in the kitchen.
The weather was cloudy that day. Jack learned a lot about math. Jack wrote about the day in the diary. I prefer trying shoes on in stores.
Jack and Max had great fun there. Max is interested in swimming. They took many photos at the shopping mall. What's more, my sister doesn't eat meat.
The cashier is one of the best places in the city. Jack's favorite animal is the elephant. Jack is going to travel to Chengdu in July.
